say:1:1010210201:1.text: You're here. I hope there was no trouble on the road.
say:1:1010210201:1.source_cn: 哦，你们来了。路上没受伤吧？

choice_prompt:2:1010210201.text: You're here. I hope there was no trouble on the road.
choice_prompt:2:1010210201.source_cn: 哦，你们来了。路上没受伤吧？

say:3:1010210202:1.text: I'm looking into the bandits around here. Did you encounter any on your way?
say:3:1010210202:1.source_cn: 在调查附近的盗匪。你们来的路上有没有遇见过？

choice_prompt:4:1010210202.text: I'm looking into the bandits around here. Did you encounter any on your way?
choice_prompt:4:1010210202.source_cn: 在调查附近的盗匪。你们来的路上有没有遇见过？

say:5:1010210203:1.text: I chased them all the way and thought they all retreated. Some of them must've slipped by me.
say:5:1010210203:1.source_cn: 啧，我一路追击过来，还以为他们已经撤退了，没想到还有漏...

say:6:1010210205:1.text: Well, here's the odd thing. The Heroic Order receives several reports a week from Northville, mostly about bandits or gruglins. The villagers were miserable.
say:6:1010210205:1.source_cn: 那么，奇怪的问题来了。我在骑士团的时候，一周内能接到北...

say:7:1010210206:1.text: By comparison, the area around Southville isn't that much better than Northville, if not worse, but the Heroic Order never got any of these reports.
say:7:1010210206:1.source_cn: 相比之下，南村附近的环境不比北村好多少，甚至更加恶劣—...

say:8:1010210207:1.text: Isn't that strange? Around here, gruglins are more aggressive, and bandits are more numerous, but no one reports anything.
say:8:1010210207:1.source_cn: 不蹊跷么？这附近的咕布林攻击性更强，盗匪数量也多，报案...

say:9:1010210208:1.text: Either the gruglins and bandits are so bad that they wiped out all Southville's villagers and left no witnesses, or...
say:9:1010210208:1.source_cn: 要么是盗匪和咕布林太凶恶，对南村村民赶尽杀绝，没有目击...

choice_prompt:10:1010210208.text: Either the gruglins and bandits are so bad that they wiped out all Southville's villagers and left no witnesses, or...
choice_prompt:10:1010210208.source_cn: 要么是盗匪和咕布林太凶恶，对南村村民赶尽杀绝，没有目击记录；要么是……

say:11:1010210209:1.text: Southville follows Lord Franz's orders. They dug up their wheat fields and planted grapes instead. Now, their lives are peaceful. What a coincidence...
say:11:1010210209:1.source_cn: 南村乖乖听从弗朗茨的话，铲掉麦田改种葡萄，于是生活平和...

say:12:1010210210:1.text: The nobility all have their secrets, but Lord Franz's secrets seem just a bit more interesting.
say:12:1010210210:1.source_cn: 贵族们通常都有秘密，不过弗朗茨老爷的秘密好像更有趣一点。

say:14:1010210211:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, Mr. Valen, but can we go talk somewhere else? You do smell the horrible stench coming from the cave, don't you?
say:14:1010210211:1.source_cn: 抱歉打断你们的谈话……维伦先生，我们能换个地方说话吗？...

say:16:1010210213:1.text: So... W-Wait! You don't mean that you want to go in there, do you? That cave smells so bad that it would knock out a gang of gruglins!
say:16:1010210213:1.source_cn: 等、等一下，难道说，你想进去调查吗？！顶着咕布林都能被...

say:17:1010210214:1.text: My dear Miss Hammie, I'm afraid you are right again.
say:17:1010210214:1.source_cn: 非常遗憾，亲爱的使魔小姐，事情恐怕正如你所想。

say:18:1010210215:1.text: Everything points to this cave as the source of the stench and the whereabouts of the bandits. I've come this far already. I need to see it through.
say:18:1010210215:1.source_cn: 这股味道的来源，还有那些盗匪的去处，都指向了这座山洞，...

say:19:1010210216:1.text: Sometimes, it's better to rip off the bandage quickly. Come on, let's hold our noses and march right in.
say:19:1010210216:1.source_cn: 所以，长痛不如短痛，捏着鼻子，进去吧。

say:22:1010210218:1.text: ... If Chippy and Valen are both going inside, then so can I! There's nothing I can't endure for the magister.
say:22:1010210218:1.source_cn: ……满满和维伦都敢进去，我也可以！没什么不能忍受的！

say:25:1010210204:1.source_cn: 可能剩下的闻风而逃了。
